Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) can be reported as a concentration, as a fraction, or as a yes or no call, and the three are not interchangeable. Parts per million (PPM) is a fraction multiplied by one million, so the number is only as meaningful as the fraction it scales: 0.01% is 100 PPM, and 0.00024% is 2.4 PPM, the lowest allele fraction Santonja and colleagues reported for ctDNA detection in breast cancer.

Nothing here gives a conversion between assays: MTM/mL cannot be turned into PPM from the printed result, and a VAF of 100 PPM at one variant is not a tumour fraction of 100 PPM.

Membrane recruitment helps organize AKT activation. PDK1 phosphorylates AKT1 Thr308, whereas the rictor-mTOR complex supplies Ser473 phosphorylation in the defined experimental route. Raptor-containing mTORC1 and rictor-containing mTORC2 are distinct complexes. mTORC1 regulates protein production and autophagy-initiation machinery; releasing initiation restraint is not proof of completed recycling flux.
